settings.heading: Exchange policy.
settings.subheading: The detailed steps for a size exchange.

settings.title: Eligibility
settings.body: Full price pairs, unworn outside. Wrong, damaged and defective pairs are covered by the Return and Exchange page.

settings.title: Five day window
settings.body: Message us within 5 days of delivery with your order number.

settings.title: Original box and Supply Unit seal
settings.body: The pair must be in its original box, with the Supply Unit seal still attached.

settings.title: Return courier
settings.body: Send the pair to us with the courier of your choice. The return courier charge is paid by the customer.
settings.dev_note: The return address for exchange parcels (shared on WhatsApp, or printed here).

settings.title: Inspection
settings.body: Once the pair reaches us, it is checked.
settings.dev_note: How long the check takes once the pair reaches you.

settings.title: Replacement dispatch
settings.body: Once the pair passes the check, your new size is dispatched.
settings.dev_note: How soon the new size is dispatched after the check.

settings.title: Sold out sizes
settings.body: If the size you need is sold out, we refund the item price to your bank account or mobile wallet.

settings.title: Sale pairs
settings.body: Sale pairs are final for size and cannot be exchanged. Defects within 30 days are still covered.

settings.title: Refund instead
settings.body: When the size you need is sold out, the item price is refunded to your bank account or mobile wallet.

settings.heading: Start an exchange.
settings.text: WhatsApp or call +92 319 9628735, or email contact@daursupply.com, with your order number and the size you need.
